levels.name: Pre-Grain
levels.subtitle: Before there was something
levels.description: A single disturbance in the unrecorded dark. Nothing recognizable has formed. Even the idea of a particle is still ahead.
levels.detail: An intentionally speculative visual metaphor: it is not a depiction of an observed pre-Big-Bang object.
levels.material: Obsidian-black, weathered surface / cold mica / one warm fissure
levels.motion: A near-imperceptible angular fluctuation and one slow incipient fissure pulse.

levels.name: Vacuum Whisper
levels.subtitle: The silence is not still
levels.description: An almost empty interval begins to register tiny fluctuations. Nothing stable has emerged, yet the quiet cannot hold perfectly.
levels.detail: The opposing surfaces illustrate the uncertainty of a vacuum without claiming that empty space literally contains visible blades.
levels.material: Pale refractive film / optical black / faint silver interference
levels.motion: Independent field flutter and traveling interference fringes.

levels.name: Quantum Foam
levels.subtitle: A brief architecture of uncertainty
levels.description: Fleeting pockets rise and collapse in a turbulent speculative visualization of quantum scale. Shape appears for an instant, then dissolves.
levels.detail: Artistic metaphor for Planck-scale speculation, not a directly observed structure.
levels.material: Pearl membrane / ice-blue refraction / vapor-violet internal light
levels.motion: Cavities swell, contract and fade out of phase.

levels.name: Symmetry Field
levels.subtitle: The first balance
levels.description: Opposing forces hold a transient geometric equilibrium. For a moment, the emerging universe can be read as a rule rather than a shape.
levels.detail: An abstract depiction of mathematical symmetry. It does not claim an observed pre-cosmological object.
levels.material: Ivory ceramic / cold slate glass / precise coral dividing light
levels.motion: Opposed planes approach alignment around a glowing symmetry axis.

levels.name: First Expansion
levels.subtitle: The interval widens
levels.description: A compact event unfolds into space. The surface does not fly through space: the represented distances themselves begin to grow.
levels.detail: A conceptual artistic representation of cosmic expansion, not an actual photographed initial condition.
levels.material: Molten copper / blackglass membrane / thin gold-white horizon
levels.motion: The causal membrane and released shards expand and settle.

levels.name: Primordial Plasma
levels.subtitle: Light trapped in a sea of charge
levels.description: The young cosmos glows with charged, interacting matter. It is luminous and opaque, as energy and material remain tightly coupled.
levels.detail: Inspired by early hot plasma before neutral atoms form.
levels.material: Radiant coral plasma / cobalt ion haze / dark filamentary currents
levels.motion: Charge currents deform while luminous turbulence travels through them.

levels.name: Quark Wake
levels.subtitle: The smallest bonds begin
levels.description: Colored constituents and the field binding them form a dynamic, unsettled cluster: structure without a familiar surface.
levels.detail: Stylized color-charge interaction, not a literal photograph of three colored quarks.
levels.material: Charged indigo / cyan ion light / orange binding filaments
levels.silhouette: Three unequal charge knots connected by flux
levels.motion: Charge knots move independently as binding flux flexes.

levels.name: Proton Seed
levels.subtitle: A durable center
levels.description: The chaos gathers into a compact nucleus of possibility. A stable constituent emerges from the earlier disturbance.
levels.detail: The shell and plates are visual shorthand for confinement, not physical mechanical parts of a proton.
levels.material: Compacted iron-grey plasma / rust-red luminous core / sharp ceramic facets
levels.motion: The bound lobes remain stable while pressure seams change luminosity.

levels.name: Proto-Atom
levels.subtitle: A new kind of enclosure
levels.description: Bound nuclei and electron clouds make the first neutral arrangements possible. A recognizable grammar for ordinary matter appears.
levels.detail: The luminous tracks depict probability distributions symbolically; electrons do not travel in these tidy planetary orbits.
levels.material: Smoked-blue probability glass / amber nucleus / translucent pale orbital membranes
levels.silhouette: Paired probability lobes around a nucleus
levels.motion: Probability lobes and contours precess independently.

levels.name: Ancient Afterglow
levels.subtitle: The universe leaves a trace
levels.description: The first light travels outward, carrying a record of what has already passed. A dim remnant spreads through the growing universe.
levels.detail: Inspired by the cosmic microwave background, represented as an imagined physical specimen.
levels.material: Smoked glass / oxidized titanium / ancient amber radiation
levels.motion: A low-frequency wave passes across a barely moving radiation fossil.

levels.name: Quiet Epoch
levels.subtitle: A darkness full of possibility
levels.description: After neutral atoms form, there are no stars yet. Gravity quietly gathers primordial gas through a long cosmic dark age.
levels.detail: The sculpted cloud is an artistic visualization of neutral hydrogen, not a literal object visible during the cosmic dark ages.
levels.material: Unlit hydrogen mist / graphite-blue interference / frozen ivory rim
levels.motion: Cold hydrogen banks gather almost imperceptibly around dim density knots.

levels.name: Gravity Well
levels.subtitle: Matter learns to fall together
levels.description: Invisible attraction becomes visible in its consequences. Gas falls into the densest region and begins the slow assembly of a future star.
levels.detail: The warped lens is a symbolic diagram of gravitational collapse, not a directly photographed spacetime funnel.
levels.material: Blackglass concavity / blue-grey gas / thin gravitational lensing
levels.motion: The curved geodesic funnel rotates around its dark focus.

levels.name: Star Ignition
levels.subtitle: The first star catches
levels.description: At last the first stars ignite. A young stellar heart shines into a universe that has known only scattered relic radiation.
levels.detail: The early star is inspired by massive metal-poor Population III star formation, with a stylized anisotropic corona.
levels.material: Blue-white photosphere / champagne plasma / ionized cyan corona
levels.silhouette: A kindling star with magnetic coronal arches
levels.motion: An unstable photosphere breathes as coronal arches and streamers deform.

levels.name: Fusion Ember
levels.subtitle: A furnace that makes new matter
levels.description: Stellar cores fuse light nuclei, forging the first steps toward a chemically richer universe. The star becomes a factory of elements.
levels.detail: An impossible cutaway visualizes the process of fusion. The layers and channels are not actual rigid structures inside a star.
levels.material: Incandescent helium plasma / dark convective ridges / gold-white central furnace
levels.motion: A stable photosphere rotates beneath independently changing prominences.

levels.name: Nebula Bloom
levels.subtitle: The first stellar nursery
levels.description: The heavens fill with structured clouds of gas and dust. Stellar radiation sculpts illuminated ridges and shadowed pillars where future generations form.
levels.detail: A cinematic nebular illustration with intentionally enlarged ionization fronts and sculptural gas pillars; not an astrophotograph.
levels.material: Volumetric indigo and cyan gas / coral emission / dust-carved pillars
levels.motion: Independent density banks drift around an embedded newborn star.

levels.name: Element Forge
levels.subtitle: A star scatters the elements
levels.description: Successive stellar generations enrich space with heavier elements. The aftermath of stellar death becomes the raw material for new worlds.
levels.detail: A sculpted explosive stellar remnant is a narrative shorthand; not all heavy elements form in the same kind of stellar explosion.
levels.material: Fractured iron-blue stellar crust / heated silicon / oxygen-teal emission / luminous ejecta
levels.silhouette: An elemental crucible shedding luminous ejecta
levels.motion: Elemental ejecta expand from a pulsing stellar crucible.

levels.name: Galactic Seed
levels.subtitle: A hidden structure gathers
levels.description: Gas falls into growing dark-matter structures. Turbulent streams converge until the first luminous galactic systems can assemble.
levels.detail: The dark-matter scaffolding and filament currents are symbolic, not a representation of directly imaged dark matter.
levels.material: Shadowed cobalt gas / smoke-violet halo / pearl lensing / cold-blue nuclei
levels.motion: Spiral inflows gather while the first stellar population turns.

levels.name: First Galaxy
levels.subtitle: Light becomes a civilization of stars
levels.description: Gravity organizes stars, dust and gas into an immense luminous community. The first galaxies establish enduring structure in the growing cosmos.
levels.detail: Its spiral silhouette is an illustrative synthesis of later spiral structure; the earliest galaxies were often more irregular.
levels.material: Dusty blue starlight / warm pearl core / indigo lanes / sparse coral emission
levels.motion: Thousands of stars rotate with the inclined spiral geometry.

levels.name: Cosmic Web
levels.subtitle: Everything begins to connect
levels.description: Matter is distributed across enormous filaments and nodes, with vast dark voids between them. Clusters and galaxies occupy the intersections.
levels.detail: The web is compressed into a readable miniature. Real cosmic filaments extend across immense astronomical scales.
levels.material: Pale cyan filament fog / dark indigo voids / pinpoint stellar density knots
levels.motion: Luminosity propagates along independently deforming filaments.

levels.name: Stellar System
levels.subtitle: A star gains an entourage
levels.description: A star and the matter around it assemble a family of worlds. Dust, ice and rock settle into enduring orbital patterns.
levels.detail: The orrery-like presentation compresses timescales and distances; planets and their orbits are not shown to scale.
levels.material: Incandescent amber photosphere / basalt planets / ice-cobalt world / slate-blue dust
levels.silhouette: A primary star and four independent worlds
levels.motion: Four worlds orbit at different speeds around a stellar primary.

levels.name: Planetary Accretion
levels.subtitle: A world starts as collision
levels.description: Dust and stone collide inside a young stellar system. Gravity draws fragments toward an incandescent protoplanet; the earliest crust forms, breaks, and reforms.
levels.detail: This is an artistic composite of accretion, molten differentiation, and impact debris, not a literal instantaneous view of planet formation.
levels.material: Black basalt / iron oxide / exposed silicate magma / steel-blue impact dust
levels.silhouette: A rocky accretion body with orbiting debris
levels.motion: Planetesimals drift inward while an accreting world turns.

levels.name: Ocean World
levels.subtitle: The surface learns to flow
levels.description: As young worlds cool, liquid water can gather at the surface wherever the conditions permit. Atmosphere, mineral coastlines and enormous bodies of water transform a battered planet.
levels.detail: An imagined ocean-bearing planet. Water is not a guaranteed next step for every planet, and the image is deliberately not to scale.
levels.material: Liquid teal / midnight ocean / pale carbonate cloud / translucent upper atmosphere
levels.silhouette: A deep ocean with interrupted atmospheric currents
levels.motion: Ocean texture and atmospheric arcs circulate at different rates.

levels.name: Molecular Chorus
levels.subtitle: Complexity finds a rhythm
levels.description: Chemistry explores endless combinations. Molecules assemble, exchange energy, form temporary bonds, and create the conditions in which more complex systems become possible.
levels.detail: The pictured network is symbolic rather than a chemically valid molecular diagram; it does not imply scientists know the exact pathway to life.
levels.material: Iridescent aqueous glass / cobalt, carbon and copper atoms / diffuse ultraviolet energy
levels.silhouette: A climbing molecular chain with reactive side groups
levels.motion: A molecular backbone flexes while reactive groups pulse.

levels.name: First Replicator
levels.subtitle: Matter begins to remember
levels.description: Somewhere amid many possible environments, chemical systems capable of copying and persisting emerge. The boundary between chemistry and biological evolution becomes profound.
levels.detail: A speculative protocell-and-template metaphor, not a historical reconstruction of the first organism or replicator.
levels.material: Translucent lipid membranes / pearl vesicles / bioelectric amber / sea-glass interiors
levels.motion: Twin membranes separate and return while internal strands move.

levels.name: Biosphere
levels.subtitle: A world becomes alive
levels.description: From chemistry to diversity: oceans, microorganisms and ecosystems begin to alter a world from within. Life becomes a planetary process, perpetually adapting and remaking its environment.
levels.detail: The droplet-shaped living world is a conceptual organism-landscape hybrid. Its evolution compresses vast intervals into one visual specimen.
levels.material: Deep-water glass / translucent jade / pearlescent water / mineral ivory / chlorophyll green
levels.silhouette: A living world encased by co-evolving fronds
levels.motion: Canopy filaments flex around a rotating ocean substrate.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.subtitle: The universe begins to notice itself
levels.description: From living processes, sensing, memory and internal models emerge. The world gains organisms able to attend to their surroundings and respond.
levels.detail: A speculative composite of a neural network and a luminous marine organism; no single moment of universal awareness is scientifically established.
levels.material: Vitreous neural filaments / pearlescent membranes / deep teal / electrochemical amber
levels.motion: Dendrites flex while traveling electrochemical impulses illuminate terminals.

levels.name: The Signal
levels.subtitle: Awareness reaches beyond itself
levels.description: Communication allows knowledge to travel from one mind to another. A gesture becomes a message, a message becomes a record, and signals cross distance.
levels.detail: A poetic progression, not a claim that electromagnetic broadcast immediately followed consciousness. The object is an invented Institute transmitter.
levels.material: Oxidized copper / black optical ceramic / thin ivory conductors / coral signal light
levels.silhouette: An offset monolith transmitter and outgoing waves
levels.motion: A resonator calibrates and sends distinct expanding transmission waves.

levels.name: Civilization
levels.subtitle: Many minds begin to build together
levels.description: Communities accumulate tools, ideas, institutions and shared memory. Structures grow from cooperation: from shelters and workshops toward archives and observatories.
levels.detail: The architecture is an imagined hybrid of cities and future institutes; it is not meant to represent a single culture or historical timeline.
levels.material: Weathered basalt foundations / ivory ceramic towers / smoky glass / inhabited warm light
levels.silhouette: An inhabited cluster of archive towers
levels.motion: Inhabited windows light in groups while skybridges carry moving illumination.

levels.name: Continuance Institute
levels.subtitle: Discovery becomes an enduring purpose
levels.description: The Continuance Institute gathers knowledge and preserves what creators discover. Understanding is no longer an accident: it becomes a responsibility carried forward.
levels.detail: This is original ANEVUM fictional worldbuilding, not a real institution or a forecast of cosmological history.
levels.material: Bone-white optical ceramic / graphite architecture / brushed platinum / precise coral calibration
levels.motion: Optical gimbals calibrate independently above preserved archive leaves.

levels.name: ANEVUM
levels.subtitle: Creation continues beyond the beginning
levels.description: The universe has gained the capacity to remember, imagine, collaborate and deliberately create. In ANEVUM, the story does not end: people carry it forward together.
levels.detail: A fictional culmination based on ANEVUM orbital-mark geometry. The prior epochs reappear as five small signals converging upon an open aperture.
levels.material: Ion-cut ivory ceramic / midnight blackglass / platinum conductors / spectral memory lights
levels.silhouette: An open orbital mark receiving five memory streams
levels.motion: Five evolutionary memory streams converge through open orbits; a new outward signal answers.

renderPipeline.material: GGX direct lighting + procedural fields + sampled albedo/height
renderPipeline.masters: 2048px straight-alpha PNG rendered with EGL OpenGL using the live GLSL
renderPipeline.textures: four 4096px procedural height/normal/roughness families; 1254px generated obsidian albedo source
renderPipeline.vector: 30 independently editable SVG field overlays; no embedded raster

nativeAnimationLimit: glTF portable loop contains node motion; phenomenon-specific deformation/emission stays in editable GLSL + scene JSON
limitations: Real-time materials are artistic approximations; no path tracing, true participating-media transport or physical refraction.
All 30 are reconstructed; artistic approval is pending. No claim that the final long-term visual standard has been approved.
Native iPhone Safari and assistive-technology acceptance require device review.
No account, achievement, XP or production site integration.
